name: Super Rom Overhand Cable Row
validation_note: Bands are the standard coaching ranges for this movement, not measured against a labelled clip. Treat a fix verdict as a prompt to look, not as a measured fault.

start_cue.en: Start with your arms long, then pull in.
start_cue.hi: Haath seedhe karke shuru karo, phir andar kheencho.

good.en: Good. You pulled all the way in.

fix.en: Pull further. Bring the weight all the way in.
fix.hi: Aur kheencho. Weight poora andar lao.

above.en: Pull further, all the way in.

below.en: Do not pull past your body. Stop when the elbow is behind you.
below.hi: Shareer se aage nahi. Kohni peeche aate hi ruko.

almost.en: Pull further. Bring the weight all the way in.
almost.hi: Aur kheencho. Weight poora andar lao.

good.en: Good. You let the weight stretch you out.
good.hi: Badhiya. Aapne weight ko khulne diya.

fix.en: Let your arms straighten fully at the top.
fix.hi: Upar jaate time haath poore seedhe hone do.

almost.en: Let your arms straighten fully at the top.
almost.hi: Upar jaate time haath poore seedhe hone do.

fix.en: You are swinging. Keep your body still and pull.
fix.hi: Aap jhool rahe hain. Shareer sthir rakho aur kheencho.

almost.en: You are swinging. Keep your body still and pull.
almost.hi: Aap jhool rahe hain. Shareer sthir rakho aur kheencho.

fix.en: Too fast. Control the stretch. Count 2 seconds.
fix.hi: Bahut tez hai. Khulne mein control rakho. 2 tak gino.

above.en: Very slow. Good control — keep moving smoothly.
above.hi: Bahut slow hai. Control achha hai, smooth chalte raho.

below.en: Too fast. Control the stretch. Count 2 seconds.
below.hi: Bahut tez hai. Khulne mein control rakho. 2 tak gino.

almost.en: A bit fast. Count 2 seconds on the way down.
almost.hi: Thoda tez hai. Neeche aate time 2 tak gino.

fix.en: One arm is doing less. Pull with both evenly.
fix.hi: Ek haath kam kar raha hai. Dono se barabar kheencho.

almost.en: One side is a little behind. Move them together.
almost.hi: Ek side thoda peeche hai. Dono saath chalao.
